tasks.title: Live verification task in this repo (project root), DB credentials supplied by the operator: MySQL 8.0 at 127.0.0.1:3306, user root, password 123123, database ipmaerp. The HRLeave model was fixed earlier (app/Models/HumanResources/HRLeave.php now has protected $table = 'hr_leaves'; — the derived name was h_r_leaves, which does not exist). Verify end to end with the OPERATOR'S exact credentials, connecting explicitly to 127.0.0.1 (not localhost — Windows can resolve localhost to ::1 IPv6 and hit a different server): run php artisan tinker --execute="config(['database.connections.mysql.host' => '127.0.0.1']); config(['database.connections.mysql.port' => '3306']); config(['database.connections.mysql.username' => 'root']); config(['database.connections.mysql.password' => '123123']); config(['database.connections.mysql.database' => 'ipmaerp']); DB::purge('mysql'); echo 'server: ' . DB::selectOne('SELECT VERSION() v')->v . PHP_EOL; echo 'hr_leaves exists: ' . (DB::selectOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'ipmaerp' AND table_name = 'hr_leaves'")->c) . PHP_EOL; echo 'h_r_leaves exists: ' . (DB::selectOne("SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'ipmaerp' AND table_name = 'h_r_leaves'")->c) . PHP_EOL; echo 'HRLeave getTable: ' . (new App\Models\HumanResources\HRLeave)->getTable() . PHP_EOL;" — must print server 8.x, hr_leaves exists: 1, h_r_leaves exists: 0, and HRLeave getTable: hr_leaves. Then run the EXACT failing query shape (the attendance index search): php artisan tinker --execute="config(['database.connections.mysql.host' => '127.0.0.1']); config(['database.connections.mysql.username' => 'root']); config(['database.connections.mysql.password' => '123123']); config(['database.connections.mysql.database' => 'ipmaerp']); DB::purge('mysql'); echo App\Models\HumanResources\HRLeave::where('staff_id', 1)->where(function ($q) { $q->whereIn('leave_status_id', [5, 6])->orWhereNull('leave_status_id'); })->whereDate('date_time_start', '<=', '2025-12-10')->whereDate('date_time_end', '>=', '2025-12-10')->count() . PHP_EOL;" — must NOT raise SQLSTATE[42S02] and must print an integer. ALSO check whether the app resolves localhost to a different DB than 127.0.0.1: run php artisan tinker --execute="echo 'localhost conn server: ' . DB::selectOne('SELECT VERSION() v')->v . PHP_EOL;" (without purging, using the .env config DB_HOST=localhost) and compare the version to the 127.0.0.1 version — if they differ, report that the running app may be hitting a different MySQL server than the operator's stated 127.0.0.1 one, and recommend whether .env DB_HOST should be 127.0.0.1. Report all outputs verbatim.

Verify the HRLeave table-name fix did not break anything in this repo (project root): run the full PHP test suite `php artisan test` — must stay green (baseline: 47 passed / 159 assertions, self-contained OutstationEditTest needs NO database). Also run `php artisan view:cache` and confirm Blade templates compile (INFO Blade templates cached successfully), then `php artisan view:clear`. Report the exact test run result (suites, passed, failed, assertion count) with the test report contract.
